verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean operator is exactly the paper's t_* + bD_r + F∂_θ + GD_z (σ = -1 branch of signedMaterialOp), and the stated right-hand side differs from the display only by distributing b and leaving n_{Φ,r} unabbreviated: b·x0 - v·b·(H_Φ)_R + εv(H_Φ)_T - εvG(H_Φ)_Z = b·(x0 - v(H_Φ)_R) + εv((H_Φ)_T - G(H_Φ)_Z), using n_{Φ,r} = x_0 - v(H_Φ)_R from phase_dR. The regrouping is a `ring` identity. The Lean statement additionally carries the hypotheses ε ≠ 0, 0 < R and differentiability of F, G at the slow point; the paper's standing setting supplies all three. The O(εS_*^C) bound on E_ik that (7.9) attaches to this identity is not part of this declaration.
